Benchmarking deconvolution

Function to aggregate cell types per method-siganture
```{r}
aggregate_cell_types <- function(deconv_df, cell_types, new_name) {
  # Identify relevant column names matching any cell type pattern
  pattern <- paste(cell_types, collapse = "|")
  matching_cols <- grep(pattern, colnames(deconv_df), value = TRUE)
  
  # Extract method_signature by removing the matched cell type from the column name
  cell_type_pattern <- paste0("_(", paste(cell_types, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  extract_prefix <- function(colname) {
    sub(cell_type_pattern, "", colname)
  }
  
  method_info <- data.frame(
    colname = matching_cols,
    method_signature = sapply(matching_cols, extract_prefix),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Aggregate per method_signature
  aggregated_df <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(deconv_df))
  
  for (ms in unique(method_info$method_signature)) {
    relevant_cols <- method_info$colname[method_info$method_signature == ms]
    
    if (length(relevant_cols) > 0) {
      aggregated_df[[paste0(ms, "_", new_name)]] <- rowSums(deconv_df[, relevant_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  return(aggregated_df)
}
```

Aggregate cells in deconvolution to match scRNA annotation
```{r}
deconv <- deconv %>%
   dplyr::bind_cols(aggregate_cell_types(deconv, c("CD8.cells", "CD4.cells", "CD4.memory.activated", "CD4.memory.resting", "CD4.naive",
                                                  "T.cells.regulatory", "T.cells.non.regulatory", "T.cells.helper", "T.cells.gamma.delta"), "Tcells"),
                   aggregate_cell_types(deconv, c("Macrophages.M0", "Macrophages.M1", "Macrophages.M2"), "Macrophages.cells"),
                   aggregate_cell_types(deconv, c("B.naive.cells", "B.memory.cells"), "B.cells"),
                   aggregate_cell_types(deconv, c("Dendritic.activated.cells", "Dendritic.resting.cells"), "Dendritic.cells"),
                   aggregate_cell_types(deconv, c("NK.activated", "NK.resting"), "NK.cells")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Quantiseq_uncharacterized_cell)
```

Groundtruth
```{r}
tab <- table(metacells@meta.data$Patient, metacells@meta.data$new_annotation)
cells_groundtruth <- as.data.frame.matrix(prop.table(tab, margin = 1))
```

Benchmark 
```{r}
corr_matrix = compute.benchmark(deconv, cells_groundtruth, corr_type = "spearman", plot = T, scatter = F, pval = 0.05, 
                                cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3", "Tcells"), file_name = "Benchmark_signatures", height = 10, width = 12)
```
